bible_verses.english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your useless way of life handed down from your fathers, but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ;
Let’s therefore approach the throne of grace with boldness, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are my wonderful, merciful Savior and the truest Friend of my soul. Thank You for the tender grace and healing You freely pour into my life whenever my heart hungers for You. I come to Your throne of grace today with gratitude, resting in the precious truth that I am redeemed. Teach me to draw near to You in every moment, offering You all my love and adoration. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: It is astonishing to think that the Creator of the universe chose to draw near to us not in overwhelming power, but as a humble, sacrificial Lamb. In Jesus, we find not only a merciful Savior who redeems our souls, but a faithful Friend who understands our deepest needs. Our hearts naturally long for healing, grace, and belonging, and Christ generously supplies them all. As you worship today, lean into His comforting presence and offer Him the adoration He so lovingly deserves.
